text:
Predicates:
InRange(x, y) ::: x is a mountain range in y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
Mine(x) ::: x is a mine.
Donated(x) ::: x was donated.
HasMineInRange(x, y) ::: range y has a mine x.
InState(x, y) ::: x is in y.

Premises:
InRange(picuris, newMexico) ∨ InRange(picuris, texas) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(juanDeOnate, picuris) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
Mine(pegmatiteMine) ∧ LocatedIn(pegmatiteMine, picuris) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine is located in the Picuris Mountains.
Donated(pegmatiteMine) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine was donated.
∀x (Mine(x) ∧ LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ (InState(y, texas))) → ¬Donated(x) ::: There are no mountain ranges in Texas that have mines which have been donated.

Conclusion:
¬LocatedIn(pegmatiteMine, newMexico) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine is not located in a mountain range in New Mexico.
